How this list was graded (stress test). Every creator was scored on four axes: relevance (hashtag fit + bio confirmation — a creator must actually talk about the niche, not just brush a tag once), authenticity (real UGC creator vs. brand/store/bot/operator), audience-tier fit (engaged micro/nano rewarded; mega generalists penalized), and reachability (email > site/link > none). Grades: A on-target, bio-confirmed, reachable · B solid fit · C plausible / needs review · D weak / unconfirmed · F = removed. Removed: competitors' own accounts, casino/operator accounts, beauty & laser clinics (#skinclub false-positives), perfume sellers (#luxdrop), content-farm/music spam, media outlets, service businesses, and mega generalists who used a niche tag once. Genuine on-target 1M+ names live in the "Mega 1M+" list, not this micro-focused grade.

The Graded list is one continuous best-fit ranking: grade stays authoritative (A→B→C→D) and within each grade creators are ranked by fit-and-value score — no niche buckets, so #1 is the single best GemBreak partner. Gambling and card-breakers interleave by merit. Click any name to open their profile. "Fit" states why the creator qualifies. Contacts are public business/booking details only.
